#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    int stringLen;
    std::cin >> stringLen;
    std::string text;
    std::cin >> text;

    std::vector<std::string> tokens;
    std::regex pattern("[^()_]+|[()_]");
    std::sregex_iterator it(text.begin(), text.end(), pattern);
    std::sregex_iterator end;
    while (it != end) {
        tokens.push_back(it->str());
        ++it;
    }

    int outMax = 0;
    int inMax = 0;
    int idx = 0;
    bool inside = false;

    while (idx < (int)tokens.size()) {
        std::string token = tokens[idx];
        if (!inside) {
            if (token == "(") {
                inside = true;
                idx++;
            } else if (token == "_" || token == ")") {
                idx++;
            } else {
                int len = token.length();
                if (len > outMax) {
                    outMax = len;
                }
                idx++;
            }
        } else {
            if (token == ")") {
                inside = false;
                idx++;
            } else if (token == "_" || token == "(") {
                idx++;
            } else {
                inMax++;
                idx++;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << outMax << " " << inMax << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
